derivation.onset: Section 6.2: earliest event time of a Grade >=1 finding. Day +2 (2033-10-26) has ICE 9/10 (Table 6 Grade 1, section 3.3), no competing cause (tocilizumab and fever are not competing causes, A35). Record is the same day, so section 7.7/7.1 tolerance 0 gives no mismatch.
derivation.max_grade: Section 3.3/3.4 and A2: highest per-assessment grade. Day +3 exam documents arousal only to light touch with no sedating drugs in 24 h, which is the Grade 3 'awakens only to tactile stimulus' criterion (touch was light, not vigorous, so not Grade 4). ICE 8 alone would be Grade 1, but the most severe domain sets the grade. Record Grade 3 equals this, so 7.7.

ambiguity_notes: Not ambiguous. The RN report of the patient up in a chair at 08:30 on Day +3 is about 3 hours before the exam and is fluctuation, not a conflicting assessment at about the same time (section 6.4). Day +5 headache is an excluded symptom (section 4.2). Tocilizumab given 04:00 on Day +2 is treatment for CRS, not a competing cause (A35).
